audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart (phases[N].side) disagreed with the content layer (win[N]) on all seven rows, and the full layer referred to Karma as "he/his" throughout.
audit.why: win[] matches the packet levelChart (Akali, Akali, Karma, Karma, Akali, Akali, Akali) and the 51.88% Akali win rate; the full layer read Karma/Karma/Skill x5. Two layers rendering different answers to "who wins Level 1".
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side realigned to win[N] as one atomic group, and the phase whys rewritten to match the new sides and Karma's actual kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes described Karma as having "both Mantra charges" / "a full-charge Mantra block".
audit.why: Mantra is a single empowerment on a 40/38/36/34s cooldown, shortened by Gathering Fire when her damaging abilities hit — not a charge system. Advice built on "she needs both charges" mistimes your all-in.
audit.corrected: Spikes now key off the 40s Mantra cooldown, the level 3 combo, Perfect Execution beating one Inspire shield, and first item beating Mantra-Inspire outright.
sources: enemyKit R: cd 40/38/36/34, 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point'

audit.whatIsWrong: The root was repeatedly attributed to "Mantra-Q" and the page implied Twilight Shroud is the answer to it.
audit.why: The root is Focused Resolve (W), a 675-range tether on a flat 12s at every rank that damages and REVEALS the target; Inner Flame (Q) is the 950-range projectile that explodes on the first enemy unit it hits, and Mantra-Q adds a delayed cataclysm. Since W reveals and is already applied, breaking it is a range/line-of-sight problem, not a stealth one — the kit text says the tether must be broken, not un-targeted.
audit.corrected: Break Focused Resolve on range or terrain; stand behind minions so Inner Flame dies on the wave; Mantra-Inspire (E) shield is what eats your combo, and Perfect Execution's second cast is what beats it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named the tether but carried no numbers.
audit.why: Focused Resolve does not scale with rank — a flat 12s — which makes the punish window countable; Inner Flame drops 9s to 5s; Mantra is 40s and shrinks as she pokes.
audit.corrected: All three cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal note despite Mantra-W healing Karma.
audit.why: Flagged in missingInteractions (needs-antiheal). Mantra Bonus on Focused Resolve heals her and extends the root, so Grievous Wounds changes extended trades.
audit.corrected: Itemization line now states Ignite's Grievous Wounds cuts the Mantra-W heal.

audit.why: Inner Flame explodes on the first enemy unit hit, so a minion line is a hard poke filter against a 950-range mage — the single most useful un-stated mechanic here.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.early, phases[0].why, whys[0] and early.
